verdict.rationale: pnpm's docs explicitly describe first-class monorepo support: a single lockfile across the workspace, the workspace: protocol for cross-linked local packages, filtering to run tasks on touched projects, and shared catalogs for version consistency, corroborated by independent community reports of successful large monorepo migrations (20+ packages) with 'built-in monorepo support just works'. Missing for 10: no first-party benchmark/case study quantifying lockfile-sharing at very large scale and no resolution of the minor community friction around workspace-file config scoping.
